value: The librarian's tenure loop: standing is EARNED by independent corroboration and lost by decay — a node minted from an utterance cannot count as resolution evidence for that same utterance, a duplicate deposit becomes a provenance append (charter edge b's recorded switch), and standing rises only when a different crossing independently walks to the node. Promotion and decay ride the resolution event; decay is computed lazily from timestamps at read. No clock, no daemon, no generate spent.

Two hand-set constants at birth, declared per learns-its-gates: the promotion threshold (corroborations-across-crossings required for 'earned') and the decay curve (how fast an uncorroborated hypothesis fades from walk reach). Minimal first values set at build with their whys beside them; the WATCHME accumulates the evidence their learning needs; a future cast moves them from hand-set to learned.

The other three rungs of the continuity ladder (idea 2026-08-09-librarian-persistence): the warm set (recency-weighted short-term working memory), the self tree (personality as a second graph tree), and consolidation at boundaries. Each is a later cast that stands on this one. Also out: any change to the chat articulation layer (the-librarian-chats, PROVED) beyond what the verdict dict already carries.
